name: Export EPUB to PDF
desc: Export the open EPUB (or PDF) to a PDF that looks exactly like it does on your Supernote: the page as the device lays it out, with your handwritten notes, marker highlights and text highlights on top. Choose annotated pages only, the current page, a page range or the whole book. The PDF is saved to the EXPORT folder. Works offline. Permissions: read (to read your annotations) and write (to save the PDF in EXPORT).
author: Gnaciux
